# rmdir

Remove empty directories through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/rmdir empty-dir

moonx cli/rmdir -p empty-parent/empty-child
```

Attempt each operand; -p also removes empty parents until a failure or a protected working-directory/root boundary.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p`, `--parents` | Remove empty parents after the operand. |
| `-I`, `--ignore-fail-on-non-empty` | Ignore failures caused only by nonempty directories. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Show removals. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Nonempty trees are not removed. POSIX directory symlinks fail; Windows may remove a junction while leaving its target intact.
- -I is a project alias for --ignore-fail-on-non-empty.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
